actual_default_host_matrix.environment: Separate loopback HTTP 127.0.0.1:18902 and HTTPS 127.0.0.1:18903; selected server deliberately default_server for both, real Nginx and real selected-site template; no aaPanel VHost modification
actual_default_host_matrix.http: 7 selected/alias/port/case authority variants observed 503 text/html exact body; 6 unmatched/missing Host variants observed untouched native default 200
actual_default_host_matrix.https: 7 selected/alias/port/case authority variants observed 503 text/html exact body; 6 unknown SNI/Host, invalid suffix, missing Host variants observed untouched default 200
actual_default_host_matrix.isolation_cleanup: Private listeners stopped and private config removed

native_site_matrix.unmatched_http_hostname_and_port: HTTP200 preserved while running, stopped and after Restore
native_site_matrix.unmatched_sni_https443: HTTP200 preserved while running, stopped and after Restore; bounded retries only for transient curl HTTP2 stream error during Nginx reload
native_site_matrix.named_https: Selected site's SNI 503 text/html while stopped; 200 after Restore/Start; 2 non-target named sites and certificates unchanged

required_02.fix: After reload and route probe, re-read exact selected native VHost and compare its loaded Nginx -T source before persisting successful journal phase. Any late writer leaves the original Recovery ID and uncertain result.

native_late_writer_fault_injection.apply: Independently appended selected-VHost comment during postreload HTTP probe; status_stopped_uncertain with stable Recovery ID, phase prepared, Recheck Recovery Required; explicit Restore preserved comment, then task-only comment removed with exact source verification
native_late_writer_fault_injection.restore: Independently appended selected-VHost comment during postreload HTTP probe; status_stopped_uncertain, phase restoring and Recovery ID preserved; unaudited source rewrite refused; after task comment's exact removal explicit Recheck/Restore reconciled with changed=false
native_late_writer_fault_injection.scope: Only selected test WordPress VHost mutated with task-owned reversible comment; other VHosts and Nginx config unchanged

required_02.runtime_claim: Final source checks prove current disk and Nginx -T source after reload; not an assertion that all earlier worker generations have exited

required_03.fix: Backend proof_kind identifies source_only, stopped_http503, native_http200, running_non503 or none; frontend validates action-state-proof contract and labels expected/stored/observed hashes separately.
required_03.armed: Prepared digest, no observed stopped HTTP503
required_03.applied_stopped: Observed 503 status, exact HTML digest and text/html
required_03.restored_stopped: Observed native HTTP200, never claims custom 503
required_03.restored_running: Non503 running response and postreload source; no claim of all old workers exiting or stopped-route proof
required_03.verification: Backend state tests and JavaScript operator-visible message assertions

rollback.method: Cold-stop managed QEMU; restore verified pretest disk; reboot and validate baseline; preserve protected snapshot
rollback.services: Nginx, aaPanel, PHP 8.1/8.5, MariaDB and guest agent

limitations: Synthetic full-admin Flask POST is not real authenticated browser/CSRF/role Phase B acceptance (#21).
Unknown-Host HTTPS/443 *management feature* remains outside this PR (#10); test proves this change does not alter fallback.
Current source/loaded Nginx config inspection does not prove all old Nginx workers have exited.
Only native aaPanel 8.0.7 Nginx test environment is covered; no release/Production deployment.
gate: New exact-candidate independent HIGH_ASSURANCE delta re-review required; no Merge without later explicit Owner approval.
